free_tier.stated: a true Free tier at $0 forever with 1 sandbox at a time, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk, up to 2 hours per session, no credit card required; Usage Credits start at a $5 prepaid pack with up to 100 concurrent sandboxes and up to 24 hours per session; all tiers run on the same Firecracker microVMs

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: 7 day retention on the Free tier, stated with encrypted storage
retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Network egress is free: the pricing page states no allowance cap and no per-GB price
egress.free_allowance: no cap stated; egress is free

interface_detail: HTTP API, the `tl` CLI, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and standard SSH, scp, sftp and rsync into a sandbox

limits.value: the Free tier allows 1 sandbox at a time and up to 2 hours per session; Usage Credits allow up to 100 concurrent sandboxes and up to 24 hours per session from $5 prepaid packs

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
